card.name: Punctuation and links in web text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires on scattered punctuation and short words in science and health web pages, such as a semicolon in a topic list, a period after U.S, or 'more' before 'information'.

modes.label: Separators in lists
modes.description: Semicolons between items in a list of science topic headings.

modes.label: Short words in page endings
modes.description: Short words or marks in closing lines of public-health text, just before a pointer to more information.

card.plain: It responds to scattered punctuation and short words in web text, with no pattern a clinician could rely on.
